name: Ghar Puja Essentials Kit
short: Roz ki pooja ki zaroori samagri
description: Ghar ki rozana pooja ke liye ek sundar, sochi-samjhi potli. Isme roli, chawal, haldi, kapoor, batti, chandan aur agarbatti shamil hain.

name: Peetal Diya Jodi
description: Mazboot peetal se bana paramparik diya. Tyohar aur rozana aarti, dono ke liye badhiya.

name: Rui Ki Batti
description: Saaf rui se pyaar se banayi gayi batti, jo pooja ke diye mein aaraam se jalti hai.

name: Shuddh Kapoor
description: Aarti aur pooja ke liye khushbudar kapoor. Hawa-band packet mein pack kiya gaya.

name: Havan Samagri
description: Havan ke liye paramparik jadibootiyon aur lakdi ka sugandhit mishran.

name: Chandan Agarbatti
description: Pooja ke waqt ke liye shaant chandan sugandh wali agarbatti. 2 packs ka set.

name: Roli Aur Akshat Set
description: Tilak aur pooja ke liye roli, haldi aur saaf akshat ka suvidhajanak set.

name: Shubh Pooja Thali
description: Tyoharon aur pooja ke liye saja hua thali set. Gift dene ke liye bhi ek pyara vikalp.

name: Tamba Havan Kund
short: Tambe ka · ghar ke havan ke liye
description: Ghar par chhote havan ke liye mazboot tambe ka havan kund.

name: Mangal Kalash
description: Grih pravesh, tyohar aur shubh avsaron ke liye paramparik kalash.

name: Aarti Ghanti
description: Aarti aur pooja ke liye madhur dhwani wali paramparik ghanti.

name: Satyanarayan Katha Kit
short: Katha ke liye chuni hui samagri
description: Satyanarayan katha aur pooja ke liye chuni hui samagri ka complete kit. Phal-phool sthaniya roop se lena behtar hai.
